name: medicita-rd
description: MediCita RD — Tu salud, nuestra prioridad. Agenda de citas médicas y estudios.

scripts.setup: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @medicita/api" "npm run dev -w @medicita/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @medicita/api && npm run build -w @medicita/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:prod -w @medicita/api" "npm run start -w @medicita/web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @medicita/api && npm run lint -w @medicita/web
